grades.lower_bound_mechanism: false Lemma 2: essential primes eventually divide all terms
grades.upper_bound_mechanism: residue enumeration mod L; broken backward-shift Lemma 6
grades.notes: Core Lemma 2 (every essential prime eventually divides every term) is false—contradicted by the write-up's own example (5 essential, 5∤36) and by a1=6 where ℰ is infinite, so L is undefined. Its proof is vague 'induction on essential rank'; finiteness of ℰ is assumed. Lemma 6's gcd identity is false; only definitional hitting-set reformulation and an eventual assembly are given.
